title: Artifact Distillation: Training-Free Transfer from Frontier to Small Language Models
author: Mustafa Safa Ozdayi, Somin Wadhwa
description: arXiv:2610.37680v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Closing the gap between frontier and smaller language models is usually approached by distillation: fine-tuning the small model (student) on a frontier model's (teacher) outputs, which binds transfer to training compute and leaves the transferred knowledge largely…
